newsitem.title: CANADA: Scotiabank CEO sees more record profits.
newsitem.headline: Scotiabank CEO sees more record profits.

text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia chairman and chief executive Peter Godsoe said on Tuesday the bank was on track for another year of record profits.
"The first quarter should be on target. We're certainly expecting our earnings to set another record," Godsoe told reporters after the bank's annual meeting.

Canada's fourth largest bank reported a 22 percent increase in net income to C$1.06 billion in fiscal 1996 ended October 31. The bank is scheduled on February 25 to report its results for the first quarter ending January 31.
Godsoe also said he expected loan losses to keep falling in fiscal 1997.
Scotiabank's 1996 provision for loan losses was C$380 million, down from C$560 million in 1995.
"Loan losses will be down. We are in a good economy so we will do well," Godsoe said.
